Maya: quick follow-up to the rollout convo
need to decide default behavior for automatic fallback: instant route swap vs shadow-probe-first. streaming chat is sensitive to latency; embeds can tolerate probe delay. ideas?

Li: prefer mode-per-route. propose three modes: INSTANT, SHADOW, DEGRADE. SHADOW = mirror a sample (no client impact) and evaluate before commit. INSTANT = immediate cut on breach. DEGRADE = route to smaller model or cached response while healing.

Asha: ops requirements: we need a manual lock (break-glass) that pins a route to a variant and blocks autoswitches. must record owner, reason, ttl, and produce an immutable audit entry. UI + API.

Tom: oncall: for /chat use INSTANT if p95 > SLO*1.25 for 20s OR errors +2% absolute. For /embed use SHADOW default. Also want pre-warm step: populate kv cache for target variant before switching. Drain semantics: allow in-flight streams to finish, block new sessions after 5s.

Raj: runtime note: store route state as CAS key in control plane: route_state:<route> -> "variant=...,epoch=...,locked_by=...,locked_until=...". Runtime watches and applies switches only when epoch increments. Helps avoid races.

Li: metrics we should emit: shadow.requests, shadow.success_rate, shadow.latency_ratio, fallback.invocations, fallback.trigger_reason, manual.lock_owner, route_state_epoch. Also enforce cooldown: max 1 auto-switch per route per 10m.

Maya: API sketch for break-glass:
```
POST /admin/locks
Body: {"route":"/v1/chat","target_variant":"redwood-13b-stable","owner":"maya","reason":"p95 spike","ttl_secs":3600}
Response: 200 {"locked":true,"expires_at":"2026-03-18T13:07:22Z"}
```
Return 409 if already locked.

Asha: UI should show timeline: lock created, auto-decisions attempted while locked, manual clears. Require "rollback_justification" field when UI triggers a rollback for audit.

Tom: runbook quick commands:
- emergency pin:
  curl -u $OPS -X POST https://controlplane/api/admin/locks -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","target_variant":"redwood-13b-stable","owner":"oncall","reason":"p95 spike","ttl_secs":3600}'
- force fallback:
  curl -u $OPS -X POST https://controlplane/api/admin/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","variant":"redwood-13b-stable","force":true}'

Li: commit flow (SHADOW): start N-minute window, mirror sample f fraction, collect success_rate and latency_ratio. If success_rate >= threshold && latency_ratio <= slack for M consecutive windows -> write new route_state with epoch+1 and emit event to events.rollout. If not, backoff and increase shadow_sample or retry later.

Maya: include hysteresis: exponential backoff for re-probing (2x up to 30m), and a cooldown of 10m after any auto-switch. Also include TTL-based unlock: locks expire automatically.

deploy-bot: Canary started 2026-03-18T12:52:10Z for model redwood-13b-q8s. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/rollouts/redwood-13b-q8s

Raj: I'll add a simple staging test that runs SHADOW 1% for /v1/chat and validates shadow.success_rate metric. Will post numbers.

Maya: thanks. when Raj posts results we'll update the RFC + add a short runbook section for break-glass procedures. :thumbsup:
